editorial.blurb: I AM Thai delivers authentic, made-from-scratch Thai cooking in a bright, modern space where passionate chefs and attentive service make every visit feel special.
editorial.insiderTip: Order at Thai spice level to experience the full flavor profile without overwhelming heat, and don't skip the Mango Sticky Rice—reviewers rave about it even out of season.

topDishes.note: Described as some of the best Thai food in the Chicagoland area
Amazing flavors and presentation; also available with pork belly
